subject: Post-demo org intake & buying-signal checklist for HealthLytix
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@healthlytics.com>, Caroline Gomez <caroline.gomez@healthlytics.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo org intake & buying-signal checklist for HealthLytix

Hi Marcus & Caroline,

Thanks again for the call today — we appreciated the candid discussion about the pilot goals and where Redwood would fit into the stack. Quick recap and a few asks so we can move the evaluation forward cleanly: 

1) Decision map: Can you share an org chart (even a simple PDF) that shows who owns AI strategy, procurement, finance/econ buyer, and the security/compliance owner for piloting external models? That helps us identify the right stakeholders to include on next calls.

2) Buyer signals & criteria: From our notes, your priorities are latency under 250ms p95, strict data separation for PHI in the pilot, and cost predictability. Please confirm if those remain the top three and whether there are any redlines (e.g., no outbound logging, specific retention windows).

3) Procurement & legal path: What is your procurement route for pilots? PO only, or do you require an SOW/contract and legal review? Who should we expect on contract threads (procurement@..., legal@...)?

4) Security evidence: The security team will likely request architecture/data-flow docs and a short questionnaire. If you have a template we should complete, please attach it. Otherwise we can send our standard SOC2 + data flow doc.

5) Timeline & budget: Confirm the internal timeline for a pilot decision and any budget bands (ballpark is fine). We heard pilot in Q4 and ~USD 80k but want to confirm.

Next steps from our side: I can share the demo recording and a short mutual action plan for the pilot once we have the stakeholder list. I copied Karthik from Solutions so he can help map technical owners. I will also loop in Ben from our deals team once procurement/contracting starts.

Would it be possible to get the org chart and procurement contact by Friday (2027-09-17)? If helpful, we can schedule a 30-min alignment with the econ buyer + security owner next week.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

Best,
Olga
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: demo-recording-20270914.mp4 (recording), mutual-action-plan-template.docx (will send after org chart)
From: Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@healthlytics.com>

Hi Olga — great demo yesterday, thanks.

Quick answers below and I attached our latest org chart (HealthLytix-org-chart-v2.pdf):

- Econ buyer: Ellen Park, CFO (ellen.park@healthlytics.com) — final signoff on pilot spend.
- AI sponsor: Caroline Gomez (copied).
- Security/CISO: Tom Reyes (tom.reyes@healthlytics.com) — he owns security gate for pilots.
- Procurement: procurement@healthlytics.com (small procurement team handles POs & vendor setup).
- Decision criteria: (1) latency SLA, (2) data handling & retention, (3) integration effort and observability. Any hard limits on token logging would be a blocker.
- Timeline: aiming to approve pilot scope and budget by end of Oct; procurement setup could take 2–3 weeks after signoff.
- Budget: agreement with your note — pilot window is ~USD 80k.

I attached the org chart and the security team asked we fill out an initial questionnaire — see attached Security-Questionnaire-HealthLytix.xlsx (they like Excel templates). Also, Tom asked for a short data-flow diagram; if you can send our standard data-flow doc that would help.

Happy to set a meeting for a short intro with Ellen and Tom — maybe Tue 21 or Wed 22 morning PT?

Best,
Marcus
Head of Platform & AI
HealthLytix

Karthik — would you be able to join the intro to answer questions about integration points (prefix caching, VPC options, and model-control policies)?

Marcus/Caroline — if procurement prefers a PoC SOW or vendor form first, please let Ben know or forward procurement@ so we can start that thread.
